sites.name: Peripheral IV Site
sites.power: Start with majority: you may take any face-up discard instead of each deck draw this turn.

sites.name: Lung
sites.power: At the start of your turn, if you have majority here, draw one additional card.

sites.name: Urinary Tract
sites.power: At the start of your turn, if you have majority here, your first card played this turn costs 1 fewer discard.

sites.name: Prosthetic Joint
sites.power: At the start of your turn, if you have majority here, you may play one additional card this turn at its usual cost.

sites.name: Central Nervous System
sites.power: If you start your turn with majority here: Your first draw action this turn draws two cards instead of one.
sites.legacyPower: At the start of your turn, if you have majority here, you may play one additional card this turn at its usual cost.

sites.name: Heart
sites.power: If you start your turn with majority here: You may discard a card from your hand to recover the top two cards of your discard pile. Choose from the cards already in the pile.
sites.legacyPower: At the start of your turn, if you have majority here, take one face-up card of your faction from your discard into your hand.

sites.name: Gastrointestinal Tract
sites.power: If you start your turn with majority here: Look at the top two cards of your deck. Keep one and discard the other.
sites.legacyPower: At the start of your turn, if you have majority here, draw one additional card.

sites.name: Genital Tract
sites.power: If you start your turn with majority here: After your first play here this turn that costs at least one discard, draw one card.
sites.legacyPower: At the start of your turn, if you have majority here, your first card played this turn costs 1 fewer discard.

sites.name: Skin & Soft Tissue
sites.power: If you start your turn with majority here: You may move one of your cards from another site into an open space here. Any cards tucked beneath it move with it.
sites.legacyPower: At the start of your turn, if you have majority here, take one face-up card of your faction from your discard into your hand.

sites.name: Eye
sites.power: If you start your turn with majority here: Look at the top two cards of your deck. Put one back on top and the other on the bottom.
sites.legacyPower: At the start of your turn, if you have majority here, your first card played this turn costs 1 fewer discard.

sites.name: Middle Ear
sites.power: If you start your turn with majority here: You may discard one card from your hand to draw two.
sites.legacyPower: At the start of your turn, if you have majority here, draw one additional card.

sites.name: Liver
sites.power: If you start your turn with majority here: The first time you tuck an opposing card this turn, draw one card.
sites.legacyPower: At the start of your turn, if you have majority here, you may play one additional card this turn at its usual cost.
